title: The Ember Road
summary: A burned road into Brightfall, a fractured shrine, a tower no one returns from. Something is moving behind the Veil, and the party is between it and what it wants.

onComplete.text: Brightfall's gates open. The innkeeper, Sera Dolthwick, knows more than she says — and says just enough to make the burned road worth investigating.

phases.label: Investigate the burned road beyond Brightfall

onComplete.text: The signs are fresh: brands on the trees, ash where there should be mud, the smell of something wrong. The Ashen Veil came this way. Recently.

phases.label: Decide how to proceed — aid the village, pursue the cult, or consult the shrine

onComplete.text: A path chosen. Each one leads to the watchtower, eventually — just through different wreckage.

phases.label: Find the fracture point where the Veil has begun to bleed through

onComplete.text: The fracture is small enough to miss if you are not looking. Large enough that something has been using it for months. The old watchtower was built to watch for exactly this.

phases.label: Enter the Old Watchtower at Gloomridge

onComplete.text: The tower's interior is older than the records say. Whoever built it knew what they were keeping watch for. The thing waiting at the top has been here longer than the tower.

phases.label: Confront the Emberwood Guardian — fight, bargain, or redeem

onComplete.text: The guardian is resolved — one way or another. The route beyond is open.

phases.label: Seal the fracture or claim the watchtower beacon — open the route to Act 2

onComplete.text: The Veilscar is ahead. Whatever the Ashen Veil was preparing in the Emberwood was only the first step. The next one is longer.
